global_boundary: Paths guide use of fixture-tested materials. They do not establish real-model skill transfer, practitioner approval, employment outcome or production readiness.

paths.capstone: Submit a versioned Eval Contract plus one independent transfer task and mark every non-fixture claim NOT_RUN.

capstone_rubric.rating_rule: Each dimension requires evidence or explicit BLOCKED/NOT_RUN. A missing blocker, missing owner or maturity overclaim prevents completion.
